Prior work administrative/clerical experience, preferably in a medical setting

Incumbent is responsible for coordinating and performing a broad range of clerical and patient care support functions within the nursing unit. Duties include reception, collecting and compiling patient data, assembling medical records, and assisting with patient admission and discharge. The position also supports professional and technical nursing personnel by taking and recording vital signs, assisting patients with hygiene and elimination, stocking unit supplies, and operating hospital equipment as directed. Additionally, this role is responsible for maintaining a clean and safe unit environment and will perform other related duties as assigned.
Required to float between UCI Health locations as needed
